description.short: OK cards and your morning pulse from 127 HQ, in a private chat.
description.full: 127 HQ sends you its OK cards and your morning pulse in a private chat. Link your Teams account from HQ with a one-time code, then type link and the code in your chat with HQ. Only you can OK a card, each card works once, and money, deletes, publishing and ad budgets are always OK'd in HQ. HQ doesn't read your chats or channels. In a channel it answers only when @mentioned, with a line pointing to your private chat.

commands.title: link
commands.description: Link with the code from HQ
